milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the chiseled_red_sandstone pillar and face it to demonstrate they have located it. Target is the center of the 5-block-tall pillar at spawn-relative [8, 2, 8]. max_distance=10 requires the player to walk at least a few steps toward the pillar (spawn distance is ~11.5) rather than satisfying it with just a camera turn from spawn. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the pillar.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the cut_red_sandstone_slab inside the covered alcove structure and face it. Target is at spawn-relative [15, 0, 15] on the ground floor of the structure. max_distance=8 requires the player to be relatively close (within or just outside the alcove) to have meaningfully 'found' the slab. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the slab, not just passing by.
